filters.q: PLACEHOLDER_TO_VALIDATE: e.g. from:noreply@fresha.com subject:(booking OR confirmed)

nodes.name: New Fresha Booking Email
nodes.notes: PROVISIONAL/TO_VALIDATE: filter query and poll interval are guesses. Needs a real sample Fresha booking-confirmation email to confirm sender address and subject pattern before this is reliable.

nodes.name: Load Mehua Config (Email Path)
nodes.notes: Centralized config, embedded here because n8n has no cross-branch config include without an Execute Workflow sub-node (not set up yet). Keep in sync with config/mehua-config.json — see workflows/README.md.

nodes.name: Parse Booking Details (PROVISIONAL)
nodes.notes: TO_VALIDATE: needs a real Fresha email. Required fields missing => parseOk=false => fails safely to NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW, never guesses a booking into existence.

nodes.name: TEST - Simulate New Booking (Dev Only)
nodes.notes: Run this manually to exercise the full lifecycle without a real Gmail inbox, real Fresha email, real customer, real Juice transaction or real WhatsApp account.

nodes.name: Load Mehua Config (Test Path)
nodes.notes: Duplicate of Load Mehua Config (Email Path) — see that node's notes. Keep in sync with config/mehua-config.json.

nodes.name: Inject Simulated Booking Data (TEST)
nodes.notes: Deposit required = Rs 500 via Juice, initial status AWAITING_DEPOSIT, per the confirmed deposit rule.

nodes.name: Compute Deposit Fields
nodes.notes: CONFIRMED: deposit_amount_mur=500, payment_method=Juice. juicePaymentDetails is still 5902 8505 (MCB Juice).

nodes.name: Log New Booking (AWAITING_DEPOSIT)
nodes.notes: Append row: Booking Reference, Client Name, Service, Appointment Date, Appointment Time, Status, Deposit Amount, Payment Method, Deposit Request Sent At, Reminder Sent At, Proof Received At, Verified At, Verified By, Verification Result, Confirmation Sent At, Notes, Source. TO_VALIDATE: real Sheet ID needed post-import.

nodes.name: Render Deposit Request Message
nodes.notes: TEMPORARY — OWNER WORDING TO VALIDATE. Do not present as Mehua's existing wording.

nodes.name: Notify Owner - Deposit Instructions
nodes.notes: Sends the drafted WhatsApp text to the owner's own inbox so she can copy-paste and send it herself. n8n does not send WhatsApp directly on the free Business App tier.

nodes.name: Update - Deposit Request Sent At
nodes.notes: Sets Deposit Request Sent At = now. Status stays AWAITING_DEPOSIT.

nodes.name: Log Unparseable Booking (NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW)
nodes.notes: Error handling: fail safely, never guess. Status = NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW, Notes = raw subject.

parameters.subject: =Booking email could not be parsed - please check
parameters.message: =A Fresha booking email arrived but could not be automatically parsed (fields missing). It has been logged as NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW. Please check it manually. Raw subject: {{$json.subject}}

nodes.name: Notify Owner - Unparseable Booking Email
nodes.notes: Never fails silently.

nodes.name: Load Mehua Config (Overdue Path)
nodes.notes: Duplicate of Load Mehua Config (Email Path) — see that node's notes. Keep in sync with config/mehua-config.json.

nodes.name: Render Deposit Reminder Message
nodes.notes: TEMPORARY — OWNER WORDING TO VALIDATE. Do not send automatically to a real customer during Phase 1 — this drafts a message for the owner, it does not send WhatsApp.

parameters.subject: =Reminder needed - deposit still pending for {{$json["Client Name"]}}

nodes.name: Update Status - OVERDUE
nodes.notes: Sets Status=OVERDUE, Reminder Sent At=now. Only a human action can move a booking out of OVERDUE (via the verification form) or resolve it manually - this node never cancels a booking.

parameters.formTitle: Report Deposit Proof Received - Mehua Lashes
parameters.formDescription: Owner-only: submit this when a client sends you a WhatsApp payment screenshot. This does NOT verify the deposit — it only flags the booking for manual verification against your Juice/bank statement.

nodes.name: Owner Form - Report Proof Received
nodes.notes: IMPORTANT: receiving a screenshot does NOT mean the deposit is paid. This only moves the booking to AWAITING_MANUAL_VERIFICATION - never DEPOSIT_VERIFIED. No OCR/AI/screenshot analysis is used anywhere in this workflow.

nodes.name: Update Status - AWAITING_MANUAL_VERIFICATION
nodes.notes: Sets Status=AWAITING_MANUAL_VERIFICATION, Proof Received At=now. PROOF_RECEIVED is logged as this timestamp rather than a separate durable status, since nothing else happens between the two in this flow - see docs/mehua-deposit-concierge-spec.md.

parameters.formDescription: Owner-only: use this ONLY after checking your Juice/bank statement yourself. This is the single point in the whole system where a deposit can be marked verified or rejected - no automated step can do this.

nodes.name: Owner Form - Review Deposit Verification
nodes.notes: Human-in-the-loop checkpoint. No OCR, AI model, screenshot analysis or text recognition may ever set DEPOSIT_VERIFIED - only this explicit owner action.

nodes.name: Load Mehua Config (Verify Path)
nodes.notes: Duplicate of Load Mehua Config (Email Path) — see that node's notes. Keep in sync with config/mehua-config.json.

nodes.name: Update Status - DEPOSIT_VERIFIED
nodes.notes: Sets Status=DEPOSIT_VERIFIED, Verified At=now, Verified By={{$json['Verified By']}}, Verification Result=Verified. This is the ONLY node in the whole workflow that can set DEPOSIT_VERIFIED, and it only runs after an explicit owner form submission.

nodes.name: Read Verified Row
nodes.notes: Re-fetches the full row (client name, service, date/time) to render the confirmation message, since the verification form only collects the booking reference.

nodes.name: Render Confirmation Message
nodes.notes: TEMPORARY — OWNER WORDING TO VALIDATE. studio_location and deposit_policy are still TO_VALIDATE placeholders.

nodes.name: Update Status - DEPOSIT_REJECTED
nodes.notes: Sets Status=DEPOSIT_REJECTED, Verification Result=Rejected, Verified By, Verified At=now. No automated message is sent to the client on rejection - this needs the owner's direct, human follow-up (payment mismatch, wrong amount, etc. all need judgement).

parameters.subject: =Deposit rejected for {{$json["Booking Reference"]}} - needs your follow-up
parameters.message: =You marked the deposit for booking {{$json["Booking Reference"]}} as Rejected. No message has been sent to the client - please follow up with them directly.

meta.note: Prototype scaffold, not yet validated against a live n8n instance or a real Fresha email. See workflows/README.md and docs/mehua-deposit-concierge-spec.md. Deposit amount (Rs 500) and payment method (Juice) ARE confirmed - only the Juice account details, message wording, policy text, studio location and Fresha email format remain placeholders.
